Rotation breadth is narrowing (0.49 eligible) with modest absorption (0.34) and one_narrative=false, so no dominant everything-narrative is in control. Cross-sectional momentum is display-only and rotation-timing has no edge; only the absolute-trend gate is validated, and it helped on this history.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff from Big Pharma/healthcare toward the lone non-crowded eligible leader, US Energy Complex: I would retire this watch only if XLE's durability_bar rises above 0.75 AND crowded_z turns clearly positive OR XLE closes below its 200-day average, whichever confirms the direction first.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the confirmed headline theme: eligible, durability 0.81 (trend-catching), breadth 1.0, and scoring 1.285. The trend-gate leg is the only validated edge, and it is satisfied here, so a low-conviction overweight in the direction of the established leadership is justified as a discipline rather than a return forecast. Crowding is flagged (z=1.33, crowded=true), which acts purely as a size-down caution, not a reason to fade.
theses.dissent: Crowding z=1.33 and the headline status itself mark the theme as extended and attention-heavy; the detector's own guidance warns that thematic attention spikes and crowding can coincide with tops, and an overweight here risks buying into a late-stage, well-owned move.

falsifier.text: PPH closes below its own 50-day average before the 30-day check-by date

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Equal-weight healthcare sits just behind Big Pharma (score 1.115) with similar trend health (durability 0.76, breadth 0.95). It provides a broader, less single-name-concentrated expression of the same defensive/healthcare leadership while remaining eligible under the trend gate. Crowding is again high (z=1.47), sized down, not faded.
theses.dissent: XLV is crowded at z=1.47 and its momentum rank is not a return forecast (rank-IC ~0); the healthcare leadership may already be the crowded consensus, leaving limited room for further broad upside before mean reversion.

falsifier.text: XLV underperforms SPY by 3% before the 30-day check-by date

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is the least crowded of the eligible higher-ranked themes (crowding z=0.53, crowded=false) and remains trend-eligible (durability 0.54, mixed hurst). It offers a non-consensus expression of the same trend discipline while avoiding the crowding flags that dominate the healthcare/defensive leaders. The case is purely structural: leadership is present but not the attention-saturated top.
evidence: crowded=false (z=0.53), one of the few eligible non-crowded leaders
theses.dissent: Hurst is mixed (not a clean trend) and durability is meaningfully lower (0.54) than the healthcare leaders; energy is a lower-quality trend and the rank itself carries no forward return edge, so the non-crowded angle may simply reflect a weaker, slower theme.

falsifier.text: XLE closes below its 200-day average before the 20-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
